result.title: Registration is a Representation Problem: Solving Whole-Body PET/CT Registration
result.comment: Technical report. First place winning solution for the MICCAI Learn2Reg 2026 PSMAReg challenge. Code and volumetric visualizations are available at www.neeldey.com/reps-for-reg . Keywords: representation learning, medical image registration
result.summary: Raw image intensities are a poor surrogate for similarity across images in correspondence problems. Further, while auxiliary segmentation labels can provide semantic identification and improve matching, they can assign only coarse identities to fine-grained anatomy and often cover only a subset of structures, particularly in whole-body settings. We present an approach that instead establishes correspondence using complementary representations of anatomy and demonstrate its utility for longitudinal whole-body PET/CT registration in the Learn2Reg 2026 PSMAReg Challenge. Our 3D foundation model, anatomix, is used to derive fine-grained, per-voxel semantic representations that are consistent across volumes, and we further employ off-the-shelf segmentation models to obtain coarse anatomical identities. Together, these representations drive a GPU-accelerated iterative registration solver (FireANTs) in a hybrid multistage framework: the first stage estimates alignment from dense multi-channel features, after which a second refines the deformation using both anatomix- and segmentation-based losses. Lastly, because registration should not introduce non-biological tumor volume changes across time, we develop lesion-specific component-wise volume preservation schemes. Without any task-specific training, our system won first place in the PSMAReg Challenge leaderboard. Code and interactive visualizations are available at http://www.neeldey.com/reps-for-reg.

AI.brief_summary: 论文面向纵向全身 PET/CT 配准，主张「配准是表示问题」：用 3D 基础模型 anatomix 得到跨体一致的逐体素语义表示，并叠加现成分割给出的粗解剖身份，驱动 GPU 迭代配准求解器，分两阶段估计并细化形变，另加病灶体积守恒约束，在 PSMAReg 挑战赛中免任务训练取得第一。
AI.relevance_reason: 来自较远的医学影像配准领域，但其用基础模型密集表示替代原始强度、并以粗分割身份作补充的做法，可能与 LVR 中内部状态是否保留细粒度视觉细节、以及表示选择如何影响后续匹配的问题相通，可供核查。
